opportunities.name: Movie night lookup and invite email
opportunities.description: For a movie title and recipient, look up IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes ratings and compose an invite email with the details.
steps: Search the movie title on IMDb and open its page
Search the same title on Rotten Tomatoes and open its page
Enter body 'Hi <name>, <day> we watch <title> (<director>, <runtime>): IMDb <score>, Tomatometer <pct>.'

instances.values: Spirited Away, tom@example.com, Saturday, IMDb 8.6, RT 96%
The Grand Budapest Hotel, aisha@example.com, Sunday, IMDb 8.1, RT 92%

opportunities.name: npm package stats to notes
opportunities.description: For an npm package name, search npm, open the package and its GitHub repo releases page, then save a stats note (version, weekly downloads, license, stars, issues, last release).
steps: Search the package name on npm and press Enter
Click the repository link to GitHub
Open Releases and record stars, open issues and last release date
Open Notes and add a note 'pkg: version, downloads/week, license, stars, open issues, last release'

opportunities.name: Recipe research to notes
opportunities.description: For a dish name, search Allrecipes, open the top recipe, check the dish origin on Wikipedia, and save a summary note with servings, rating, time, ingredients and origin.
steps: Search the dish on Allrecipes and press Enter
Record rating, time and key ingredients
Open Notes and add a note '<dish> for N: recipe (rating, time), needs ingredients. Origin: X'

instances.values: pad thai, 2 servings, Thailand (after mistyped lemon tart queries)
